text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a large-scale library reorganization underway,
student volunteers had joined in alongside the library committee.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Since I'm always being allowed to read all sorts of books,
I... I have to do my b-best to tidy up...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Still, our section is the race history shelves, eh?
This... might tempt my hands to stop organizing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. What Rice-kun is holding...
is a collection of stories about famous Umamusume, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. There are lots of stories Rice knows
too. Some of them have even been made into movies...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Behind every running Umamusume,
there are countless stories unfolding.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The great feats achieved, and the devotion supporting them.
The glory and setbacks, as well as dramatic comebacks."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Every single one is a timeless tale handed down through the ages.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-san's is... a foreign book?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Rather than personal episodes...
this one focuses on the racing world's "history."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The evolution of the Umamusume world merging with entertainment.
The changes in related technology.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fwehhh... That sounds kinda difficult.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Some of it can be a bit complicated, but...
learning it will help us seek out a better future.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What we have here is a collection of such things.
The hopes and ways of life of our predecessors, preserved in books.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Leaving something behind, huh... I hope what Rice is feeling right now
can reach someone out there in the future too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Even if you feel like you're unfortunate, there will always be someone cheering for you as you give it your all—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A story about an Umamusume who found happiness herself,
just by bringing happiness to everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, yeah.
I completely fell for Rice-kun's smile.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Her presence will surely remain in people's hearts for a long time.
What that smile brings is universal hope.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I just wish I had something I could leave behind for future generations, just like she did, you know?
choice_data_list: Though I think what you're holding is pretty much half the answer.
I think what you're holding is half the answer, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? This?
These are just some miscellaneous thoughts I jotted down—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter what others think.
Only those who believe in themselves and keep running
can grasp this power.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: When one truly believes in their own growth, the experience gained through trial and error tends to be vastly greater than usual—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"As long as the total sum of my compounded efforts keeps coming out ahead...
even if I get a late start, I'm bound to catch up eventually."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No... You're right.
Heh, that was a blind spot of mine."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Looking back, this growth theory was something I constructed for myself to take on natural-born prodigies, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Believing in growth, sparing no trial and error.
Knowledge and experience shaped through endless accumulation.
Can this not be passed down to those with ambition?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To leave this uncompiled would be unthinkable.
You're in for a busy time, Trainer-kun. Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, a book was donated
to the library by Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The book was titled "The Growth Theory of the Ambitious."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compiled for ambitious hard workers challenging mighty talents,
this is the will she sought to leave behind for the era.
